workload_requirements: Primary workloads: real-time support chat (chat generation) and nightly reranking batch jobs
Latency SLO: p99 <= 250ms for chat flows under steady-state; target p50 70-90ms
Throughput: expect bursts to 300-500 rps during peak; steady 60-120 rps
Batch reranking: up to 20k queries/hour, tolerant of longer tail but needs throughput predictability
model_preferences: Prefer open/quantized variants for cost (7B/13B quantized) for majority traffic
Occasional access to larger 70B style models for complex summarization tasks
Want Redwood-verified perf profiles and ability to pin model versions for rollouts
routing_and_fallback: Need automatic fallback to smaller quantized model when Dedicated capacity constrained
Multi-region routing: NA primary, EU secondary for EU customers; data residency controls required
Prefer policy: latency-first for chat routes, cost-first for nightly reranks
security_review_notes: SOC2: requested latest Type II report and gap remediation plan
SSO/SAML: need SP metadata endpoint and IdP testing window; user provisioning via SCIM desired
Audit logs: granularity to token-level request/response metadata + ability to export to customer's SIEM
Retention controls: configurable retention windows per-log-type; ability to purge data on-demand
KMS/HSM: require customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) for any persisted artifacts; key rotation policy must be documented
VPC: require private endpoints for inference; no public egress for model KV cache; diagram for peering and NAT required
Compliance groove: some EU customers require data residency in eu-west-1 only
